input.summary: Implemented an in-memory Task Management API in TypeScript with an EventBus and services: UserService, ProjectService, TaskService, CommentService, NotificationService. Built an HTTP API router using Node's http module (routes for users, projects, tasks, comments, notifications). Included src/main.ts to start the server and src/demo.ts to demonstrate creating users, project, tasks, comments, assignments, status changes, and notifications. Added tsconfig.json. All code compiles with npx tsc --noEmit.
